title: Panorra API Go Get Project Report

issues.display_title: Issue #504: Add Public Fields to User Profile
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 20/08/26

✅ Implementation: Add Public Fields to User Profile

Route

GET /users/profile/:username
Authorization: <JWT token>

Changes

  • Extended the profile query to select city, cover_image, and website from users.
  • Added a query for type and url from user_social_links by target user ID.
  • Ordered social links by position ASC.
  • Initialized social links as an empty slice so JSON returns [] when none exist.
  • Return an internal-server-error response when the social-link query fails.
  • Added focused dry-run query tests for selected profile fields and social-link ordering.
  • Updated the API collection's unencrypted success example with all four fields.

Data Flow

  1. Resolve the requested username, including the existing my-user alias.
  2. Load the target profile and its public fields from users.
  3. Load the target user's social links in display order.
  4. Add social_links to the existing profile response.
  5. Continue through the existing block, follow, counter, slim, and encryption handling.

Files

  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go
  • src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser_test.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/User/Profile User.yml

Verification

gofmt -w src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser.go src/Action/V1/Users/ProfileUser_test.go
go test ./src/Action/V1/Users
go test ./...
git diff --check

All Go tests and the diff check pass.

Endpoint

GET /users/profile/:username

Scope

  • Return cover_image, city, social_links, and website for the requested profile.
  • Read cover_image, city, and website from users.
  • Read social_links from user_social_links, ordered by position ascending.
  • Return social_links as an empty array when the profile has no links.
  • Preserve existing profile access, block, follow, encryption, and slim-response behavior.

Request

GET /users/profile/example-user
Authorization: <JWT token>

Response Fields

{
  "cover_image": "https://example.com/cover.jpg",
  "city": "Jakarta",
  "social_links": [
    {
      "type": "instagram",
      "url": "https://instagram.com/example-user"
    }
  ],
  "website": "https://example.com"
}

cover_image, city, and website may be null when no value is stored.

issues.display_title: Issue #505: List Posts Liked Another User
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 20/08/26

✅ Implementation: List Posts Liked by Another User

Route

GET /users/:username/liked
Authorization: <JWT token>

Changes

  • Registered the username-based liked-post route and controller action.
  • Added target-user lookup by decoded username.
  • Reused the existing liked-post query, pagination, filtering, and response builder.
  • Allowed authenticated user and viewer roles.
  • Added target-profile checks for banned, deactivated, and requester-blocked users.
  • Preserved filters for unpublished, private, banned, blocked, and deactivated post owners.
  • Added query and route regression tests.
  • Added an API collection request with success and user-not-found examples.

Data Flow

  1. Decode the username path parameter and load the active target user.
  2. Validate the requesting role and authenticated user data when applicable.
  3. Reject unavailable or requester-blocked target profiles.
  4. Query public liked posts using the target user's ID.
  5. Apply requester-specific blocked-post and blocked-owner filters.
  6. Return paginated posts using the existing profile-liked response shape.

Files

  • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts_test.go
  • src/Controllers/V1/LikesControllers.go
  • src/Routes/V1/LikesRoutes.go
  • src/Routes/V1/LikesRoutes_test.go
  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Likes/User Profile Liked Posts.yml

Verification

gofmt -w src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts.go src/Action/V1/Likes/ListProfileLikedPosts_test.go src/Controllers/V1/LikesControllers.go src/Routes/V1/LikesRoutes.go src/Routes/V1/LikesRoutes_test.go
go test ./src/Action/V1/Likes ./src/Routes/V1
go test ./...
git diff --check

All focused and repository-wide Go tests pass. The diff check reports no errors.

Endpoint

GET /users/:username/liked

Scope

  • Return posts liked by the user identified by username.
  • Support authenticated user and viewer roles.
  • Return only published, non-private, non-banned posts from active owners.
  • Exclude posts and owners blocked by the requesting user.
  • Reject banned, deactivated, or blocked target profiles.
  • Reuse the pagination and response shape from GET /users/me/liked.

Request

GET /users/example-user/liked?page=1&limit=9
Authorization: <JWT token>

Success Response

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "List Profile Liked Posts",
    "posts": [
      {
        "slug": "post-slug",
        "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg"
      }
    ],
    "total": 1,
    "page": 1,
    "limit": 9
  }
}

Defaults: page=1, limit=9.
